text:
Nora (Support): FYI - activation failures spike affecting trials: Northway and Helix. UI shows "activation_pending" and some 500s from provisioner. Northway renewal in 3d, flagging as high priority.

Alex (CS): Thanks. Can you paste sample errors and if manual provisioning works? We should prep a calm customer note and offer a live check.

Nora (Support): Logs:
```
2026-05-08T09:11:02Z ERROR provisioner: quota allocation failed req=req_abc123 tenant=northway
2026-05-08T09:11:04Z WARN proxy: upstream 502 for webhook tenant=helix
```
Manual admin provision succeeds for some tenants via admin UI -> manual-provision.

infra-bot: Root cause: recent rate-limiter change reduced burst for new tenants. Hotfix rolling to restore previous burst window. Expected mitigation 15-30m.

Bri (CS Ops): I'll mark Northway in CRM as renewal-risk and draft message. Suggested outreach: short, transparent, offer 7-day extension if unresolved in 24h. PTAL.

Tom (Sales): Please loop me before any credit offers on Northway renewal. I'll be on their pre-renewal call.

Alex (CS): Action items: 1) Bri draft and send outreach once patch verified; 2) Nora run manual provision for Northway if needed and confirm; 3) Tom hold on negotiation until we see recovery. Keep thread updated.

Nora (Support): Patch deployed; provision success back to baseline ~99% over 10m. Running final sweep and will post confirmation.

Bri (CS Ops): Draft sent to Northway + Helix with offer of 7-day extension and option for a 15-min live check. CC Tom. Marking incident for postmortem doc.

Tom (Sales): Thanks - I'll join the check if they accept.

Alex (CS): Thanks team. Will follow up on renewal status after Northway's reply. :thumbsup:
